My office dress code says: “No jeans on weekdays.”
A new hire read it and said, “Understood.”
On Monday, he walked in wearing a pair of dark blue trousers.
They looked exactly like jeans.
They had the stitching. The pockets. The faded knees.
HR asked, “Are those jeans?”
He said, “No. The label says ‘denim-style
work trousers.’”...

I took a 21 year old to a nice restaurant last week.
She ordered the cheapest thing on the menu. $18 pasta.
She said: "You don't have to spend a lot to impress me. I'm just happy to be here with you."
My ex was 29. She ordered $87 steak, $22 cocktail, then complained the steak was "too chewy" and made me send it back. Twice.
Same restaurant. Different woman. Different energy.
The 21 year old said thank you 4 times. To me, and to the waiter.
